summary.text: Luc Noiset, also known as Luke, is the Democratic candidate for the Georgia House of Representatives, District 36, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Republican Ginny Ehrhart.
An economist, he says in his Ballotpedia survey that he is an economics professor with 30 years of teaching experience and a U.S. Treasury economist.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia lists Noiset's career experience as working as an economist.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as an economics professor with thirty years of experience teaching the role of government in a capitalist economy, a U.S. Treasury economist, and a government tax and budget expert who has advised foreign government finance ministries.
His survey's key messages criticized actions by President Donald Trump toward the press, universities, judges and elections, and urged voters to support Democrats.
